articles.summary: MIAMI, FL (June 9, 2025) – Amerant Bank, Florida’s bank of choice with a growing presence across South Florida, has named Elliot Shafer as SVP, Head of Business Development. articles.title: AMERANT BANK ANNOUNCES HIRE OF ELLIOT SHAFER AS NEW HEAD OF BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
